    Who is the greatest Boston Celtic player of all time?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    The best Boston Celtics player of all time is widely considered to be Bill Russell, due to his unparalleled 11 NBA championships in 13 seasons, 5 MVP awards, and revolutionary defense, though many also place Larry Bird (3 MVPs, 3 titles) and John Havlicek (leading scorer, 8 titles) in the top tier of Celtics legends. The debate often centers on Russell's unmatched winning or Bird's overall offensive talent and impact in a more modern era, with players like Paul Pierce, Kevin McHale, and Jayson Tatum also considered among the franchise's all-time greats. 
    This video discusses the top 30 greatest Boston Celtics players of all time:
    58s
    Basketball Universe
    YouTube · Feb 29, 2024
    The Top Tier (The "Mount Rushmore")
    • Bill Russell:
      The consensus greatest winner in basketball history, anchoring the Celtics dynasty with his defense, rebounding, and 11 championships. 
    • Larry Bird:
      A prolific scorer, passer, and clutch performer, leading the 1980s Celtics to three championships and winning three straight MVPs. 
    • John Havlicek:
      Known as "Hondo," he's the Celtics' all-time leading scorer, a tireless defender, and an 8-time champion, bridging multiple eras. 
    Watch this video for a discussion on the best Celtic of all time:
    42s
    CLNS Media Press Room
    YouTube · Aug 10, 2018
    Other Legends in the Conversation
    • Paul Pierce:
      "The Truth," a Finals MVP and key leader for the 2008 championship team, holding franchise records for three-pointers and steals. 
    • Kevin McHale:
      A dominant power forward, multiple MVP, and crucial part of the 1980s dynasty. 
    • Bob Cousy:
      "The Cooz," the original point guard genius, leading the early dynasty and winning MVP in 1957. 
    • Jayson Tatum:
      The current superstar, already considered a top-5 Celtic by some and expected to break scoring records. 
    Ultimately, while Russell's rings often put him at the top for sheer winning, Bird and Havlicek are essential to the franchise's legacy, making the choice highly subjective depending on what qualities (winning, skill, era) one values most.
